issues.legal_issue: Whether the testimony of a sole eyewitness was sufficiently credible and reliable to support the convictions.

Whether the prosecution proved the accused persons’ participation in the murder beyond reasonable doubt, including through the evidence of hostile witnesses and despite omissions, discrepancies, and the eyewitness’s relationship to the deceased.
Whether delay in the first information report reaching the Magistrate undermined the prosecution case in the absence of demonstrated prejudice.
Whether the convictions based on the evidence and the concurrent findings of the lower courts warranted interference under Article 136 of the Constitution.
